about_the_game:
A Taste of Greece brings a variety of greek cuisine menu items, a new hand-made location, new build mode items and, of course, a greek inspired food truck!

Greek food is one of the most popular cuisines and is enjoyed around the world. From delicious Gyros to tasty Halloumi, Greece offers something for everyone! This expansion adds some of the best (and most popular) Greek-inspired meals there are. You also gain access to Olive Plaza, an infamous site where a historical duel took place between the then King of the Island, Theo III and the Leader of the Pirate Invaders, Captain Otis Glacier, also known as the Cold Captain, attracting many tourists to the island every year, acting as the perfect site for you to set up your Grub Truck and serve some delicious Greek street food!

With all the money you're going to be raking in, you're gonna need a new truck! Why not splash the cash and get the fancy GlobeHauler Demeter - a special Grub Truck, designed specifically for Greek-inspired food trucks! Once you've bought 1 (or 2, or 3, or more) you're gonna need some automation! Why not hire one of the new 11x Managers that this expansion adds.

And 

You can decorate any of your trucks with a range of new items that this expansion adds. Want to show your strength as a Grub Truck Entrepreneur? Buy some Soldier Statues! Want to wiggle your green thumb? Hang up some of the new beautiful flower pots on your walls!

A Taste of Greece gives you a completely new environment to play Grub Truck in, whilst keeping the mechanics simple!

Hungry yet? Well you're about to get even hungrier, here are all of the menu items that this expansion adds:

  • Gyros: A perfect hand-held meal of meat (choose from Chicken, Lamb and Pork), salad (lettuce, tomato, cucumber and onions) and chips, wrapped in a perfectly warm pita bread, all drizzled with a decadent tzatziki sauce.

  • Souvlaki: Tender cubes of marinated meat, skewered and grilled to perfection.

  • Moussaka: A delicious baked dish layered with eggplant, minced meat, and creamy béchamel sauce.

  • Greek Salad: A small refreshing side salad composed of lettuce, cucumber, tomato, onions, feta cheese and black olives.

  • Bowl of Olives: Love them or hate them, you can't beat a small bowl of olives on a warm summers day.

  • Halloumi: While not typically from the Greek Cuisine, these cheese sticks pair perfectly with all of the above menu items.

Now that you're running a thriving business, you're gonna need some new managers! This DLC adds lots of new Managers: 4x Common, 3 Uncommon, 2x Rare, 1x Epic and 1x Legendary, all for you to recruit!

Common

  • Freddy Feta: Novice Chef

  • Manos Mishaps: Novice Chef

  • Christos Keftedes: Apprentice Chef

  • Sofia Spinaki: Junior Chef

Uncommon

  • Smi Souvlaki: Skilled Chef

  • Pita Piper: Skilled Chef

  • Uncle Yani: Expert Chef

Rare

  • Pete Tzatziki: Senior Chef

  • Mama Dimitra: Senior Chef

Epic

  • Harry Hummus: Master Chef

Legendary

  • Jamie Olive-Tree: Legendary Chef

This expansion brings lots and lots of awesome additions to the Build Mode to help you decorate your truck to your heart's content:

  • Boreas' Fridge

  • Gyros Props: 3 Types

  • Giant Olive Props: 3 Types

  • Wide Flowerbed: Terracotta & Stone

  • Flower Basket: Terracotta & Stone

  • Soldier Statue: Sword, Shield & At Ease

  • Lady Statue: Pouring & Carrying

  • Man Statue: Scroll & Speaking

  • Basic Candle: Normal & Short

  • Ancient Rug: Diamonds (Blue), Diamonds (Green), Diamonds (Red), Flowers (Blue), Flowers (Grey), Flowers (Red), Jigsaw (Blue), Jigsaw (Green), Jigsaw (Sandstone), Swirls (Blue), Swirls (Green) & Swirls (Grey)

  • Fancy Hanging Flower Pot

  • Tall Candle

  • Fancy Candle


A Taste of Greece also adds a new truck for you to use! Introducing the GlobeHauler Demeter. As a result of its wall stability, this truck requires two awkward but small walls in the centre of the sidewalls to keep it sturdy. But don't worry! The walls are perfectly aligned with the serving window to allow you to separate your actives into two open-plan rooms.

Whilst cooking tasty Gyros in Olive Plaza, be sure to pay close attention to the new events added to the game!

Olive Fest: On Olive Day, tourists flock to Chestnut Ridge to try out the region’s best olives.

Zeus' Thunderstorm: Being on a small island surrounded by miles of sea, storms here can be a bit ... rough. Locals believe that it is the God of Sky and Thunder (Zeus) showing his force.

A Gift from the Gods: Occasionally some tasty Greek ingredients may be gifted to you, keep your eyes peeled!


Enjoy serving up tasty grub whilst listening to the new Duel at Olive Plaza track (only available at Olive Plaza).
